questions.question: When the build finishes and every test has passed on all three platforms, which of these release channels should the new version be published to first, and should the others follow?

options.label: The stable channel, published at once to every user who has automatic updates turned on and to the download page
options.description: everyone gets it today, which is the fastest way but also the riskiest if a regression slipped through the checks

questions.question: Which of the following platforms should the release notes, the download page and the announcement mention explicitly by name?

options.label: macOS on Apple silicon and on Intel processors, both signed and notarized by the release workflow
